findings.text: Lookup of a per memory group writeback object returns the device root object when the group has no parent and otherwise searches a tree keyed by group identity while validating that the block group association still matches and that a reference can be taken

Creation of a per group writeback object rechecks existence under a global lock and discards stale entries on association mismatch then allocates and initializes a fresh object and links it into device and group collections only when the device root remains registered and both group lists remain online with identifier collision treated as success

Backing device information objects are allocated zeroed on a node and initialized with default ratio limits and list and wait queue state then registered under a generated identity in a global ordered tree and list with device creation and root writeback linkage while unregistration removes global visibility shuts down writeback objects clears ratio state and tears down device and owner references

Mapping from an inode to its backing device uses a safe fallback for absent inodes then a block device association when the superblock denotes block storage and otherwise the superblock default while device naming falls back to an unknown label when no device exists and owner assignment warns on overwrite and holds a device reference

Contiguous area descriptors expose base address derived from the single range start and total size derived from page count shifted by page size together with a name string while global storage consists of a fixed capacity array plus a live count

Bitmap handling for contiguous areas derives capacity from range length scaled by granularity and converts page counts with alignment upward then shift while mask and offset helpers support alignment requests and clearing updates the bitmap and the available count under lock with zone validation cached in flags and requiring each range to sit within a single zone

Pageblock type initialization coerces movable types when grouping is disabled and rejects direct isolation while freeing drops a reference and either releases frozen pages or splits non compound high order tails with tag accounting adjusted accordingly and reserved contiguous blocks are cleared and handed to the buddy system with managed and contiguous counters updated

Managed page accounting adds to zone and global totals and refreshes low memory reserves where each zone keeps per upper zone cushions proportional to upper managed pages divided by configured ratios with monotonic growth across upper zones and total reserves sum the per zone maxima plus high watermarks clamped to managed pages

A per group writeback object is uniquely identified by memory group identity within a device tree and remains usable only while its block group association matches the current effective association and while the device root stays registered

Each registered backing device carries a unique increasing identity ordered in a global tree and list with initial ratio limits at zero minimum and full scale maximum and with read ahead and io sizing taken from a shared readahead default and writeback capability enabled at allocation

Global lock cgwb_lock guards tree cgwb_tree plus linkage into lists wb_list and cgwb_list plus offline marking and cleanup queue handling with interrupt saving acquisition for creation and with lock dropped across potentially blocking cleanup work

Global lock bdi_lock acquired in bottom half safe mode protects ordered tree bdi_tree plus global list bdi_list while teardown asserts the lock is held and removal is followed by expedited grace period synchronization

Each contiguous area uses dedicated field lock plus allocation mutex alloc_mutex to guard bitmap mutation and available count updates while device teardown serializes draining with dedicated release mutex cgwb_release_mutex and switching uses dedicated semaphore wb_switch_rwsem

A writeback object carries device and group associations in fields memcg_css and blkcg_css plus reference counting in refcnt plus membership nodes bdi_node and memcg_node and blkcg_node and offline_node plus work items switch_work and release_work plus state flags and attached tracking

A backing device descriptor carries reference count refcnt and capability flags and ratio limits min_ratio and max_ratio and max_prop_frac plus sizing ra_pages and io_pages plus device pointers dev and owner and name dev_name and numeric identity id plus tree node rb_node and list nodes bdi_list and wb_list plus root object wb and tree cgwb_tree and wait queue wb_waitq

A contiguous area descriptor carries name and node nid and counts count and available_count plus granularity order_per_bit and range count nranges and array ranges each with base_pfn and count and bitmap and early_pfn plus lock and alloc_mutex and flags

Per group writeback lifecycle moves from absent to created and linked when online checks pass then to killed on group offline or association change then to offline queued and finally reclaimed after attached inodes are switched with dirty objects deferred to a later pass

Backing device lifecycle moves from allocated and initialized to registered with global visibility and root linkage then to unregistered with global removal and root shutdown and per group teardown and finally to released with root exit and memory reclamation guarded by warnings against release while still registered or visible

Contiguous area activation moves from reserved ranges to bitmap allocated to zone validated to pageblocks initialized and marked activated with any failure leading to bitmap release and optional return of pages to the buddy system plus zeroing of counts and error logging

Group offline entry points iterate the respective group list killing each writeback object then poison the list head to block future creation and schedule asynchronous cleanup that skips dirty or unreferenced objects and repeatedly invokes per object reclamation with scheduling points until quiescent

Subsystem initialization sets up release work handling with limited concurrency and per device tree and synchronization primitives plus root writeback state bound to root groups while reserved area startup walks the global array activating each entry

Concurrent creation may race in the tree with collision reported as success for the loser and concurrent association change may invalidate a looked up object requiring revalidation while offline cleanup must not reclaim dirty objects because switching would drop bandwidth enforcement

Teardown must remove global visibility before shutting down writeback objects and must drain the device list under release serialization with lock released across blocking shutdown plus poisoned group lists must be checked before linking new objects to avoid resurrection after offline

Fields min_ratio and max_ratio and max_prop_frac default using scale BDI_RATIO_SCALE and base FPROP_FRAC_BASE while capability BDI_CAP_WRITEBACK is set and fields ra_pages and io_pages use default VM_READAHEAD_PAGES

Contiguous management uses capacity MAX_CMA_AREAS and per area range limit CMA_MAX_RANGES with flag bits CMA_ACTIVATED and CMA_ZONES_VALID and CMA_ZONES_INVALID and CMA_RESERVE_PAGES_ON_ERROR controlling activation and validation caching and error handling
Writeback registration state uses flag WB_registered and contiguous logging uses prefix cma while trace creation is enabled via a dedicated macro

Low memory cushions are non decreasing across upper zones for each lower zone with zeroed entries when ratios are unset or zones lack managed pages and per node and global totals derive from per zone maxima plus high watermarks

Bitmap granularity is governed by order_per_bit with capacity as range length shifted down and page to bit conversion aligning upward before shifting and alignment mask empty when requested order does not exceed granularity
An alternate build configuration provides minimal device setup that only initializes the root writeback object with empty teardown and lock free list linkage
